title: ABC Plan: Roadmap Continuation Runtime
goal: Continue the Odysseus multiagent roadmap serially through claimable nodes, installing each completed feature on the Debian homeserver before starting the next feature.

active_feature.why_first: The operator has approved crossing the policy gate in a controlled way: build an auditable mutation patch contract before the full write-capable visual editor.

continuation_policy.rule: After a feature is committed, pushed, installed live, and smoke-verified, choose the next claimable roadmap node from specs/roadmaps/odysseus-multiagent-roadmap.v1.json by dependency satisfaction and priority_rank.
must_not_stop_at: one passed gate when the feature still has open completion evidence
feature_done_only_when: all scoped repository changes are committed
roadmap status and handoff evidence are updated

current_evidence.notes: roadmap-reconciliation-import is live on the Debian homeserver.

non_goals: Do not start visual Roadmap Lens before PlanRuntime source-of-truth prerequisites are satisfied.
Do not start live subagent execution while the runtime is still explicitly fake/offline.
Do not let agents directly mutate roadmap truth; reports must be reduced into accepted events.
Do not batch several unrelated feature commits into one live install.
stop_rules: Stop on unrelated staged files or dirty files in an active write scope.
Stop on secrets, tokens, raw chat IDs, raw private source content, or raw provider output.
Stop on destructive git, rollback, force-push, delete, or broad host shell needs.
Stop when live server access fails with SSH/auth errors.
Stop when focused tests fail and the fix would leave the feature scope.
Stop when the next roadmap node is not claimable because dependencies, gates, or collision data are ambiguous.

paths.goal: Review the current roadmap policy language and propose the smallest completion criteria for rolling-frontier-policy.
paths.completion: A compact report lists policy gaps, wording to preserve, and unsafe shortcuts.

paths.goal: Inspect current runtime models and propose the smallest AgentReport/PlanEvent implementation surface for the next node.
paths.completion: A compact report lists files, tests, schema choices, and reducer boundaries.

paths.goal: Implement or codify the active feature, run focused checks, commit, push, install live, and advance to the next claimable node.
paths.completion: Feature is live and the roadmap records evidence and the next active node.

slices.objective: Record continuation policy and verify the active roadmap node after the previous live install.
tests: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json for touched JSON files
done_when: continuation policy exists
active feature is explicit
automation can continue beyond the next gate

slices.objective: Complete rolling-frontier-policy as an enforceable roadmap policy node with claimability, depth, gate, collision, and continuation rules.
tests: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json for touched JSON files
done_when: rolling-frontier-policy requires live install evidence before the feature is accepted as complete
read-only-agent-report-protocol becomes the next active feature
automation remains active for the next claimable node

slices.objective: Add the first AgentReport validation and report-to-plan-event reducer surface after rolling-frontier-policy is live.
done_when: AgentReport schema validates
read-only scope and redaction checks exist
proposed events remain proposed until accepted
future context uses accepted summaries rather than raw reports
feature is pushed and live installed

slices.objective: Expose the visual-agent-programming roadmap branch as a read-only API projection with policy-gated controls, explicit blocked actions, and next-step context.
tests: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json for touched JSON files
done_when: PlanRuntime has a claimable visual-agent-programming-readonly-lens node
the route returns a read-only snapshot
all visual controls are policy_gated
blocked actions include no graph mutation and no agent start
feature is pushed and live installed

slices.objective: Add a dry-run validation contract for proposed visual roadmap edits, reporting collisions, stop rules, and schema failures without writing roadmap state.
tests: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json for touched JSON files
done_when: proposed visual edits validate against PlanRuntime shape
unsafe edits return structured stops instead of writes
no dry-run result can start an agent
feature is pushed and live installed

slices.objective: Expose validated visual plan edit proposals as a read-only review queue with explicit accept/reject boundaries and policy-gated controls.
tests: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json for touched JSON files
done_when: proposal queue snapshot lists pending proposed events and validation outcomes
accept/reject controls are visible but policy_gated
no queue item mutates the roadmap or starts an agent
feature is pushed and live installed

slices.objective: Define an explicit operator-gated acceptance contract for reviewed visual proposals, keeping accepted events auditable and separate from agent starts.
tests: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json for touched JSON files
done_when: acceptance request validation requires explicit operator confirmation
accepted/rejected event projections are auditable
acceptance never starts agents
feature is pushed and live installed

slices.objective: Create the first write-capable bridge as a patch contract: accepted visual proposals become auditable patch documents with permission mode, visual plan status, version, and timestamp metadata.
tests: PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json for touched JSON files
done_when: existing nodes can be connected as a patch proposal
new nodes can be created from an existing node as a patch proposal
default permission requires extra confirmation unless approve_for_me is explicit
patch metadata includes status, version, timestamp, and audit
feature is pushed and live installed
